configuration: ./Config.pl -default -v=Empty,OH/BATSRUS,PT/FLEKS; ./Config.pl -o=OH:u=OuterHelio,e=OuterHelio,ng=2,g=4,4,4 -o=PT:lev=5, then make SWMF and make rundir. Decks Param/PARAM.in.test.OHPT.FLEKS.outerhelio.4neu.start, Param/PARAM.in.test.OHPT.FLEKS.outerhelio.4neu.couple unchanged. The couple stage of the upstream four-neutral-fluid outer-heliosphere test: the relaxed solar wind is restarted and OH is coupled to PT/FLEKS, which now carries the particles. run.sh runs the start stage first as an ungraded prerequisite. Graded: oh_y0.out.
observable: the final state of the graded window as the upstream check reads it: oh_y0.out
variant: The OH #SOLARWINDH solar-wind proton density, set in both stage decks, multiplied by 1 + 2e-10 in ic/variant and printed to twelve significant digits -- a relative change far below any physically meaningful difference in the input and an order of magnitude above the last digit the coarsest graded ASCII file carries. It is generic numerical-noise calibration: the two inputs differ by one number, and the spread between the two runs is the floor this pass policy can be held to.
altbuild: run.sh altbuild rebuilds the same pinned source and deck with ./Config.pl -O0 (every OPTn line of Makefile.conf forced to -O0 where the shipped gfortran template builds at -O3, which is what both the Fortran rules and the C++ rule of Makefile.conf use, so the framework, BATSRUS and the FLEKS solver are all rebuilt); the floor it measures is written into evidence.floor by selfcheck.

evidence.floor_how: measured by selfcheck: run.sh altbuild against run.sh nominal, graded with this check's own validate.py

warrant: CALIBRATION RUN: the bound of this rubric is deliberately loose (|dx| <= 1e-12 + 1e-3|ref|) so that selfcheck run 1 measures the variant spread and the altbuild floor of every graded file without failing on them; the graded bounds are written from those measurements before run 2.
